_note: Monthly rules and calendar refresh (BETA_CONVERSATION_SPEC 3.3; app/research/rules_refresh.py). targets: per policy file, the items to check: glob is a path of keys and list indexes where * matches every key or index (keys starting with _ are skipped), fields are the values the model reads from the item's source, sources names the item's key holding its URL (a string or a list; the first https URL is read). Items sharing a URL are checked with one page read and one model call; each counts against PAI_RULES_REFRESH_MAX_CALLS. Only a page on the source's own site is read (a redirect elsewhere is unread); PDFs are read as text. A value becomes a proposed diff only when it differs from the current value and its quote is on the page (line breaks ignored), is a real passage (quote_rules: min_chars characters, min_words words) and states the new value: a number as a number, a month of a *months field by a name in month_names, text as itself, every element of a list. Nothing is applied: scripts/apply_refresh.py applies a reviewed proposal. validation_tests are what apply_refresh runs before keeping a change.
